title: Установка Forgel Code обычным pip, pipx — необязательный вариант
requirements: `README.md` install section's first command block contains a `python3 -m pip install` command pinned to an exact revision (tag, commit hash or exact version); no floating branch is used as the default.
The first install command block does not require pipx and can be executed with only Python and pip.
README shows installing inside a virtual environment (create/activate plus `python3 -m pip install`).
README shows a `--user` install for a system Python where no virtual environment is created.

README states where the `forgel-code` executable is placed (virtual environment `bin`/`Scripts` directory or pip's user scripts directory) and how to add that directory to PATH, including how to locate it if unknown.
README documents the fallback launch `python3 -m forgel_code` and includes a version check example (e.g. `python3 -m forgel_code --version`).

README's update section describes upgrading by installing a newer pinned revision with `python3 -m pip install --upgrade` and/or `--force-reinstall`, and explicitly covers the case where the version number is unchanged but the commit differs (forcing reinstall of the pinned commit).
`pipx` appears at most once in `README.md`, is explicitly marked as optional (an isolation alternative), and appears after the pip installation instructions.

README keeps the existing stated constraints: build needs no dependencies and no network, editable installation is not supported, and the `forgel` engine must be available via PATH or `--engine`/`$FORGEL_ENGINE`.
A documentation test checks that the first install command in the README install section is a plain `python3 -m pip install` (or `python -m pip install`) command and fails if it is not.
The documentation test checks that if `pipx` appears in `README.md`, it appears after the pip instructions and within an explicitly optional-marked line, failing otherwise.

An installation test creates a temporary target directory, installs the local source tree with plain pip in a no-network configuration (e.g. `--no-index`/`--no-build-isolation` as appropriate to the existing build backend), and asserts exit code 0.
The installation test asserts that the installed `forgel-code --version` prints the installed version and exits 0.
The installation test asserts that `python3 -m forgel_code --version` (run against the installed target) prints the installed version and exits 0.
No file under `forgel_code/` is modified by this task.
The existing test suite in `tests/` continues to pass unchanged.
acceptance: The first command block in the README installation section contains `python3 -m pip install` with a pinned revision and does not require pipx.
README shows both a virtual-environment install and a `--user` install.
README explains where to find the `forgel-code` executable, how to fix PATH, and how to run the client via `python3 -m forgel_code`.
pipx is mentioned at most once, marked optional, and positioned after the pip instructions.
The update section describes moving to a newer pinned revision via pip, including the unchanged-version-number case.
The documentation test passes and fails as designed if the first install command stops being plain pip or if pipx appears earlier or without an optional marker.

The installation test passes: in a temporary directory without network, the client installs with plain pip, and `forgel-code --version` and `python3 -m forgel_code --version` print the installed version with exit code 0.
The existing client test suite passes with no behaviour change.
The diff contains no changes to files under `forgel_code/`.
constraints: Работа идёт только в репозитории `code`; движок `main` и его контракт команд не трогаются (D-002, D-003).
Клиент остаётся без сторонних зависимостей: установка не должна требовать setuptools, индекса пакетов или сети.
Публичные тексты — на английском (D-025); отчёт в чате — на русском.
Тесты не ходят в сеть и не поднимают внешних сервисов.
Не ослаблять существующие тесты; при расхождении чинить продукт или посылку теста.
assumptions: Задача относится к репозиторию `code`: его README.md описывает установку Forgel Code (`pipx install "git+https://github.com/forgel-dev/code@v0.1.0"`, исполняемый файл `forgel-code`), а pyproject.toml объявляет `name = "forgel-code"` и точку входа `forgel_code.cli:main`; обсуждаемый раздел установки находится именно там. Репозиторий `main` — движок (src/forgel, registry, jurisdiction) и остаётся нетронутым.
Запасной запуск через `python3 -m forgel_code` возможен: в пакете есть `forgel_code/__main__.py`.
Проверка установки выполняется из локального исходного дерева с отключённым индексом пакетов и без изоляции сборки, чтобы не ходить в сеть.
Пометка о необязательности pipx формулируется по-английски вместе с остальным README.

external_dependencies.name: pip (plain pip bundled with Python)
external_dependencies.interface: `python3 -m pip install` for normal installs, plus `--user`, `--upgrade`, `--force-reinstall`, `--target`, `--no-index`, and `--no-build-isolation`; the install test uses local-source, offline pip installation into a temporary target.
external_dependencies.evidence: The repository environment provides Python 3 with its bundled pip, invoked as `python3 -m pip`. The README install/update sections and the installation test use that local pip CLI with a pinned revision and with `--target`, `--no-index`, and `--no-build-isolation` for an offline local-source install.

external_dependencies.name: Python standard library `venv`
external_dependencies.interface: `python3 -m venv <dir>` creates the documented isolated environment; the installed client is then at `<dir>/bin/forgel-code`, with activation via `<dir>/bin/activate`.
external_dependencies.evidence: `venv` is part of the Python 3 standard library used by the project. The README’s primary installation path can therefore show `python3 -m venv .venv` and use `.venv/bin/forgel-code`, without any external package or service.

external_dependencies.name: PEP 517/518 build backend interface
external_dependencies.interface: pip builds the local source tree through the project’s in-tree backend declared by `pyproject.toml`; tests call pip with `--no-build-isolation --no-index`, so the repository’s `_build_backend.py` is driven directly and no network or extra build dependency is needed.
external_dependencies.evidence: `pyproject.toml` declares the project build backend and `_build_backend.py` implements the PEP 517 hooks used by pip. The dependency specification explicitly identifies this local backend as the path pip uses to build the wheel offline.

external_dependencies.name: `forgel` engine binary (external program)
external_dependencies.interface: The client resolves the engine from `PATH`, or from `--engine <path>` / `FORGEL_ENGINE`. Install tests use `forgel-code --version` and `python3 -m forgel_code --version`, so a deterministic fake `forgel` executable is sufficient for PATH/option-resolution tests; tests must not require real engine semantics.
external_dependencies.evidence: README.md documents the existing constraint that the `forgel` engine must be available through `PATH` or supplied via `--engine`/`$FORGEL_ENGINE`. The engine is not vendored in the repository and no real engine binary is declared by the environment contract, so tests must use a fake executable rather than the real engine.
